description: The fix/action queue for a domain: each AI-visibility gap with its stable gapKey, current status (todo / doing / done), title, category, impact, effort, and the concrete fix. Pass a scanId (exact audit) OR a domain (uses that domain's newest audit). Use set_gap_status to update a gap. Requires a signed-in account.

domain.description: Bare domain, e.g. 'acme.com' — uses its most recent audit. Optional if `scanId` is given.

scanId.description: Audit id (from list_audits) to read gaps from. Optional if `domain` is given.

name: list_gaps
